target.basis:
H-MTP2: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash DSpark MTP on the generic HBM die at 1M -- the multi-position (P-row) record design,
ranked top-down from a throughput target, timed on the batched verify compiler (hgi_sim.ds_mtp_verify) with the
command processor modelled (timing.schedule S2, per layer segment).

TARGET (stated basis): >= 3,500 tok/s MTP at 1M context, tau 4.159 (DSpark gamma 5, owner 6-class blend; the DS ROM
basis), 1.2 GHz: one DSpark step <= tau x 1.2e9 / 3,500 = 1,426,029 cycles.  3,500 = 1.74 x the same die's AR
(2,010 tok/s, option B attention on the SM engines, same program and price table): MTP must pay at least the
accepted-cost ledger's worth over AR (owner: MTP is required and paying) with margin for the unpriced 4-PC service /
v15 VM costs; it is 83 % of the DS ROM design's 4,238 tok/s (the same tau).

draft_att_pricing: option B: measured SM attention spans, /home/ubuntu/wt/hbm-mtp-1015/results/hbm_sm_attention_1015/b_measured_model.json exposed

draft.note: row-serial DSpark draft as lowered (5 block rows one at a time per stage, column swaps), priced at the sim's --price-pos

COLL.change: COLL.ROW_GATHER / TOPK_MERGE / kv_gather / ARGMAX_MERGE take R = P rows: one message train of P payloads (I operand m = P id lists, O stride a row); the endpoint/crossing/tail paid once
COLL.area_basis: record decode row counter + descriptor stride adders in the COLL record adapter

SU_DMA.change: indexed SU.VOP (route gathers), DMA.KVWB_DS (P rows, window ring 256 slots), position-addressed DMA.LOAD rows, FUSED.QDQ, ARGMAX.LOCAL take R = P rows
SU_DMA.area_basis: row counters + per-row I / dyn_sel stepping in four record adapters

IDX.change: IDX.TOPK route top-6 R = P rows (heap reset a row) + the verify expert-UNION record; IDX.INDEX P queries over ONE key stream (query slots x P, compute serial)
IDX.area_basis: P x 4,096-word query store (SRAM) + union bitmap 384 b + heap row reset

FUSED.change: FUSED.HC_PRE_NORM / HC_POST R = P rows on the LL lanes: gain sectors kept across rows, two r slots (row p+1's phase A overlaps row p's csum / rsqrt tail), per-row scalar set (PRE 4 / POST 20 words a row)
FUSED.area_basis: 32 lanes x (x buffer 2 x 20 sectors + 6 x 20 scalar words) flops ~ 200k DFF x 0.486 um2

HC.change: HC.HC_MIX R = P rows: HCP streams P h rows against stationary mix weights (measured x6 mode, II 250), SU pre/post rows, Sinkhorn x 3 units (II 634 / 3 < 250)
HC.area_basis: 2 more ot_hdc_sinkhorn (16 quotient paths + 512-entry seed each, ~0.06 mm2) + row sequencing

ATT.change: option-B attention records R = P query rows: fixed spans (first access, dispatch, publish, cross-SM merge) once, the KV line stream once per pass, component span x ceil(P / query slots) (query slots = the SM MAC slot sets)
ATT.area_basis: per SM: 6 query-slot stores (512 FP32 each, SRAM) + row tags; 32 SMs

SM_HOLD.change: SM line hold (slot port k = 1): one HBM read of each weight line serves P slots in P issue passes (op_xb + slot field [4:2] + per-slot x base); never faster than the HBM share
SM_HOLD.area_basis: per SM one 136 B line held x IL 8 + slot tag; 32 SMs

SM_K2.change: SM MAC slot sets k = 2 (the P-slot port of HGI-1 spec 6.7 at 2 slots a pass): ceil(6 / 2) = 3 passes, 3 / 1.374 of the HBM-bound line time
SM_K2.area_basis: 1 more block-dot set a SM (32 ot_gpu_bd_col LB2 at 9,123 um2 = 5,474 um2 std cells routed / 0.6) x 32 SMs + the line hold -- ESTIMATE from the routed bd_col, H-SM to measure

SM_K3.change: SM MAC slot sets k = 3 (spec 6.7 P-slot port at 3 slots a pass): ceil(6 / 3) = 2 passes, 2 / 1.374 of the HBM-bound line time
SM_K3.area_basis: 2 more block-dot sets a SM (same basis) -- ESTIMATE, H-SM to measure

SM_K6.change: SM MAC slot sets k = 6 (one pass, spec 6.7 'issue unchanged')
SM_K6.area_basis: 5 more block-dot sets a SM (same basis) -- ESTIMATE

VM.change: VM +150k words: the P verify columns' h / PRE resident (no per-layer column swap)
VM.area_basis: +150k x 32 b SRAM at the VM's 1.5 mm2 / 256k-word density
